test.create_query: CREATE TABLE byte_size_string_subcolumn_perf ( event_time DateTime, service LowCardinality(String), message String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (service, event_time) SETTINGS string_serialization_version = 'with_size_stream', min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO byte_size_string_subcolumn_perf SELECT toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number % 86400 AS event_time, arrayElement(['api', 'worker', 'web', 'scheduler'], number % 4 + 1) AS service, randomString(512 + number % 1536) AS message FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE byte_size_string_subcolumn_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1
test.query: SELECT service, toStartOfHour(event_time) AS hour, count() AS events, sum(byteSize(message)) AS message_memory_bytes, quantile(0.99)(byteSize(message)) AS p99_message_memory_bytes FROM byte_size_string_subcolumn_perf WHERE event_time >= toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') AND event_time < toDateTime('2026-01-02 00:00:00') GROUP BY service, hour ORDER BY hour, service FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1, optimize_functions_to_subcolumns = 1, optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_uncompressed_cache = 0
